_source: UMD Transportation Services Campus Parking Map 2025 (updated 2/26), page 1 'Parking Restrictions', 'Special Restrictions', 'Overflow Parking Lots' and 'Visitor Parking' panels. Rule text transcribed verbatim from the PDF.
_note: Rules are data, not code. Edit this file to change app behaviour; the engine reads it at runtime. Times are campus local (America/New_York). A window whose 'to' is <= 'from' wraps past midnight.

_access_values.permit_lot: Requires a valid CLPR/permit for THIS specific lot.
_access_values.open: Anyone may park, no permit needed.
_access_values.pay: Anyone may park but payment is required.

unrestricted_after_4pm.label: Unrestricted after 4PM
unrestricted_after_4pm.required_text: 7am - 4pm Mon. - Fri. valid lot # campus parking reg. required.
unrestricted_after_4pm.restriction_text: Free parking 4pm - 7am Mon. - Fri. and all day Saturday and Sunday. Commuter registrants may not park overnight Mon. - Fri. from 3am - 5am.

exclusions.text: Commuter registrants may not park overnight Mon-Fri from 3am - 5am.

restricted_after_4pm.label: Restricted after 4PM
restricted_after_4pm.required_text: 7am - 4pm Mon. - Fri. valid lot # campus parking reg. required. Only F/S reg. allowed at all others times.
restricted_after_4pm.restriction_text: Only faculty/staff with a valid CLPR/permit may park from 4pm - 7am Mon. - Fri. as well as all day on Saturday and Sunday.

modified_restricted.label: Modified restricted
modified_restricted.required_text: 7am - 4pm Mon. - Fri. valid lot # campus parking reg. required. F/S reg. required 4pm - 8pm Mon. - Fri. and all day Sat. and Sun.
modified_restricted.restriction_text: Only faculty/staff with a valid CLPR/permit may park from 4pm - 8pm and all day on weekends. Anyone may park from 8pm - 7am Monday - Friday.

restricted_24h.label: 24-Hour restricted
restricted_24h.required_text: 24 hours a day 7 days a week valid lot # campus parking reg. required.
restricted_24h.restriction_text: Only individuals with a CLPR/permit corresponding to these lots may park here at anytime.

special_restrictions.label: Special Restrictions
special_restrictions.restriction_text: KK requires lot KK CLPR/permit 7am - 8pm Mon. - Fri. TV requires lot TV CLPR/permit 7am - 4pm Mon. - Fri. YC requires lot YC CLPR/permit 7am - 6pm Mon. - Fri. Only valid CLPR/permit required all other times. BB, D, E, GG2, and HP (ADA Parking only) requires CLPR/permit or payment required at all times.

KK.text: KK requires lot KK CLPR/permit 7am - 8pm Mon. - Fri. Only valid CLPR/permit required all other times.

TV.text: TV requires lot TV CLPR/permit 7am - 4pm Mon. - Fri. Only valid CLPR/permit required all other times.

YC.text: YC requires lot YC CLPR/permit 7am - 6pm Mon. - Fri. Only valid CLPR/permit required all other times.

BB.text: ADA Parking only. CLPR/permit or payment required at all times.

D.text: ADA Parking only. CLPR/permit or payment required at all times.

E.text: ADA Parking only. CLPR/permit or payment required at all times.

GG2.text: ADA Parking only. CLPR/permit or payment required at all times.

HP.text: ADA Parking only. CLPR/permit or payment required at all times.

overflow.text: Overflow Parking Lots for Registered Parkers. Students: Lot 4. Faculty/Staff: K, P, U, V, X, XX1, Z, SDG, 1, 3, 4, 6, 9, 11, 15, 16, 17, 19.

gated_lots.text: Gated Parking Lots: Lots Y and W1.

ada.text: Accessible parking spaces available in parking lots and garages. Campus parking registration / permit may be required.
ada._gap: UMD publishes no per-lot ADA space counts or locations. The CampusServices 'Disability' layer contains disability service offices only, not parking. Do not synthesise this data.

pay_parking.text: All pay area parking, including meters and pay stations within and around permitted lots, payment required daily, 7AM - midnight.
pay_parking.visitor_garage_text: Mowatt Lane, Regents Drive, Stadium Drive and Union Lane parking garages.

permit_model._note: UMD does not publish a permit -> lot eligibility table. The map establishes only these conventions. Replace resolveEligibleLots() in the engine when a real DOTS source exists.
permit_model.text: Signs that begin with a LETTER are considered faculty/staff lots, regardless of any sub-number that follows it. Signs that begin with a NUMBER are considered student lots.
